evals.prompt: Add Schema.org JSON-LD structured data to our SaaS website homepage. We are called DevGuard, a developer security tool. We need Organization and SoftwareApplication entities.
evals.expected_output: Provides valid JSON-LD script using @graph unifying Organization and SoftwareApplication entities. Includes name, url, logo for Organization, and name, operatingSystem, applicationCategory, and offers for SoftwareApplication.
assertions: Defines Organization with name and url
Recommends validating with Google Rich Results Test

evals.prompt: We have an FAQ section with 3 common questions about pricing and cancelation. How do we mark this up for Google rich snippets?
evals.expected_output: Provides FAQPage JSON-LD schema with mainEntity array of Question items each containing acceptedAnswer with Answer text. Reminds that FAQ questions must be visibly present on the rendered web page.
assertions: Structures Question and Answer hierarchy correctly
Emphasizes visible content correspondence with rendered DOM
Recommends placing inside script type application/ld+json

evals.prompt: Our documentation has a 3-level breadcrumb path: Home > Docs > API Reference. Provide the schema markup.
evals.expected_output: Provides BreadcrumbList schema with itemListElement containing ListItem objects with position 1, 2, and 3, matching names and item URLs.
assertions: Sets sequential position integers starting at 1
Includes name and item URL for each breadcrumb

evals.prompt: How do I configure nginx reverse proxy for SSL termination?
evals.expected_output: Negative trigger test: This request is for web server administration and is unrelated to Schema.org structured data.
